overview.text: Amarpreet Singh Malik is an attorney and business owner who attended La Cañada Unified schools. He has served on the district's parcel tax oversight committee. His priorities include maintaining academic excellence and ensuring parcel tax and bond funds are spent transparently. In a Los Angeles Daily News questionnaire, he said the board's core job is setting strategic direction, overseeing the budget, evaluating the superintendent and being transparent. In an Outlook Valley Sun candidate questionnaire, he said a parent's perspective is essential on the board.
